thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT PD-8234 fired on service 'prod-requests' (high 5xx rate). Routing policy: 'prod-service-bindings'. Current on-call schedule: 'contractors-oncall'. Paging 8 responders.

maya: Wait, contractors? why are external contractors in a prod paging list?

sam: seeing it too. getting pages from PD. I only see contractor emails in the list. This is wrong.

alex: ACKed via PD to stop repeat pages. I can stay on it for now. who bound the schedule?

ops-bot: Incident PD-8234 acknowledged by alex. Paging paused for responders in escalation layer 1.

chris: alex thanks. quick check — I queried service bindings: ```pd service show --id svc_prod_requests
name: prod-requests
escalation_policy: ep-prod
integrations: pagerduty
bindings:
  - schedule: prod-oncall (SCHED-100)
  - schedule: contractors-oncall (SCHED-543)  # duplicate binding
notification_rules: default
```Looks like a duplicate schedule binding slipped in during last week's onboarding change.

maya: ugh. that contractors schedule is for contractor rotation used for staging only. how did it get attached to prod?

sam: there was a config import from the infra repo on Thu 2029-11-08 by user: infra-batch. Likely a YAML merge conflict introduced the extra binding.

alex: for immediate mitigation, can we remove the contractors schedule from the service binding (non-destructive change)?

chris: doing a dry-run: ```pd service edit --id svc_prod_requests --remove-binding SCHED-543 --dry-run``` dry-run looks good.

ops-bot: Running change now.

chris: change applied. ```pd service edit --id svc_prod_requests --remove-binding SCHED-543``` removed contractors-oncall from service.

pagerduty-bot: Change successful. All future pages for service 'prod-requests' will use schedule 'prod-oncall' only.

alex: nice. re-enabled paging? we should monitor if any escalations still pending.

ops-bot: Incident PD-8234 is still open. We're monitoring. Current error spike persists but paging risk reduced.

maya: what's customer impact? any active sessions dropped?

sam: early analysis: spike from inference runtime 12 on cluster us-east-1b causing 502s to API clients. Traffic down ~4% success rate for 30s windows. Some customers (2 enterprise tenants) reported increased latency via logs.

chris: correlating logs with model-serving autoscaler — autoscaler hit a failure to attach GPUs around the time. I'm rolling a quick patch to fallback pool.

alex: if the autoscaler fix will take >10m, we should open a customer-facing incident note. I'll draft a brief note in status page.

maya: +1. alex can you post: brief cause, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m, affected tenants: Tenant-A, Tenant-B, workaround: retry? Keep it high level.

alex: posted to status.redwood.com: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting a subset of customers in us-east-1. Mitigation in progress, ETA 30m."

pagerduty-bot: User alex added a note to PD-8234: "service binding fix removed contractors schedule; mitigation: routing to primary prod-oncall, rolling fallback to standby pool." 

sam: after chris's patch, error rate dropped to baseline. looks like autoscaler fallback completed and servers came back.

ops-bot: PD-8234 resolved by chris. Resolution: autoscaler fallback applied; removed erroneous schedule binding. All pages silenced.

chris: quick postmortem items: 1) revert infra-batch auto-merge rule for PD service YAMLs; 2) add CI check that disallows multiple schedules on prod services; 3) runbook update to include manual verify step for service->schedule mappings. I'll file the tickets.

maya: please include action owner for ticket 3 and target sprint.

chris: ticket created ENG-3245, owner: chris, target: next sprint. ENG-3246 for CI check, owner: sam. ENG-3247 for infra-batch rollback, owner: maya.

alex: thanks everyone. follow-up: confirm contractors didn't access any customer data — security, can you confirm?

sam: looked at audit logs, contractors were paged but didn't access prod systems. PD pages only. No API keys rotated or used. I'll add to the incident record.

maya: closing notes: cause = accidental duplicate schedule binding from automation merge; impact = short 5xx spike for some customers; mitigation = removed binding + autoscaler fallback; actions = infra CI and runbook. Good catch.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 15-min postmortem sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. Invite: maya, chris, sam, security.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8234 resolved and closed. Final note appended by alex.

ops-bot: Reaction: — maya added :white_check_mark: to summary.
